title: Enterprise reserved throughput profiles & elastic burst policy triage
creator: Evelyn Park
description: Create a repeatable intake and triage rubric for enterprise Dedicated capacity requests that captures required SLA targets, reserved throughput profiles, GPU class recommendations, and elastic/burst scaling policies. The output will be a playbook and intake form used by Sales/CS to fast-qualify requests and by Eng/Infra to scope capacity/design. Focus on non-bug requests (new customer onboarding, capacity commitments, burst behavior), account for compliance constraints (VPC/on-prem), and produce clear handoffs to engineering runbooks.
goals: Define a minimal set of fields for intake forms to capture throughput SLA, 99th/95th p99 latency SLO, burst windows, and retention of KV/cache
Create mapping from workload profile to recommended GPU class (A100/H100/L4 equivalent) and quantization guidance
Specify elastic burst policy templates with billing/overage rules and autoscaling triggers
Deliver a playbook and decision matrix that reduces triage time to <48h and improves scoping accuracy for Dedicated onboarding
acceptance_criteria: Intake form available in the Sales/CS Slack app and Confluence with required fields and examples
Decision matrix that maps 3 canonical workload profiles (low-latency chat, high-throughput async generation, embedding batch) to recommended GPU classes and reserved throughput tiers
Two burst policy templates documented (predictable short bursts, sustained burst with buffer) with cost/latency trade-offs and billing implications
Handoff checklist to Eng including estimated GPU-hours, required SLOs, compliance notes, and follow-up engineering tickets
Playbook reviewed and signed off by Infra Eng lead and Head of Sales
tasks: Draft intake form fields and example completed forms (Evelyn)
Survey top 12 enterprise customers for preferred burst models and SLAs (Rohan)
Work with Serving Runtime team to produce GPU class mapping table (ENG-4821 owner)
Draft two burst policy templates and cost model with Finance
Create Confluence playbook page and Sales-facing one-pager
Run tabletop with Eng/Infra/Sales to validate handoff checklist
risks_and_tradeoffs: Conservative GPU recommendations reduce risk but increase cost to customers — need clear docs on quantization/caching to mitigate
Allowing sustained burst policies increases complexity of autoscaling and billing reconciliations
Aggressive latency SLOs for very high-throughput profiles may require dedicated isolation which reduces multiplexing efficiency
